tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description:
## Description
Manually adds new tasks to the currently connected project.

## Must
- Do not add tasks that are already in the project.
- Be sure that the user requested to add new tasks.
- If tasks are not requested but would be beneficial to add, ask the user for confirmation before adding them.
- If you think debugging is needed, ask the user for confirmation before adding them.
- If user requested to add debugging tasks, set depedencyIds field as taskIds of related implementation tasks. (string array)

projectRoot.description: Root directory of the working project of MCP Client. This is the directory where the project is located.

taskId.description: The unique ID of the task. (example: `T-001`)

summary.description: A brief summary of the task. (example: `Develop user login page`)

aiPrompt.description:
A detailed prompt to implement the task. (example: `### Task: Develop User Login Page

**Objective:** Create a fully functional login page as per the PRD specification.

**Details:**
- Implement email/password authentication.
- Include 'Forgot Password' link.
- Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can successfully log in with valid credentials.
- Error messages are displayed for invalid login attempts.
- Page is responsive across all specified devices.`

importance.description: The importance level of the task (MUST, SHOULD, COULD, WONT).

urgency.description: The urgency level of the task (1-10). 10: right now, 7: in the next 1-2 weeks, 4: in the next 1-2 months, 1: in the next 1-2 years

complexity.description: The complexity level of the task (1-10). 10: very complex, 7: complex, 4: medium, 1: simple

dependencyIds.description: An array of task IDs (e.g., ['T-001', 'T-002']) that this task depends on.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description:
Updates the status of a task (BACKLOG | IN_PROGRESS | DONE)

## Must
- If you want to move to DONE, **be sure** that the task's acceptance criteria is met perfectrly. If you can't sure, ask the user to confirm.

taskId.description: ID of the task to update status (e.g., TASK-001)

status.description: The status of the task (BACKLOG | IN_PROGRESS | DONE)
